title: Herbert Otto's party with the George Lewis band
summary: They recall a party where part of the George Lewis band played, tape recorders ran, and a photographer attended.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: One I remember for sure, and it was, it was a particularly exciting one, because somehow he got part of the George Lewis band there, uh, I think Herb Moran was there, too. Uh-huh. And you were there, don't you remember, wasn't Herb there?
Well, uh, if it's the one I'm thinking about, uh, you know, of course I can't place it, both Talbot and Moran were there, full George Lewis band, Talbot Moran, Burbank, and Bob Matthews.
Why, why Bob Matthews? Why do you include Bob Matthews?
Because he's on the tapes. Oh, is he? Oh. Yeah.
Yeah, I remember the tapes, and I remember the music was fantastic.
Yeah, both Herbert and, and, uh, Bob Greenwood had their tape recorders going. Now that, I don't remember that much about. Yeah.
I don't remember that much about it either, except the music impressed me as being extremely good.
It seemed there were a lot of people there, and I'm having an awfully good time. Yeah. I don't remember any dancing, though there may have been.
There was some dancing.
Yeah. There was, there was some guy named John Myner who took photographs. Years later, I discovered we're at the same party by looking at the photographs.
I don't remember. I see, had Myner Sinski come to town with him? Myner?
I don't think so. Myner?
Right now. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
I don't think so. Bob Greenwood had met her at the, uh, uh, working at, she worked at the Tulane Library.
Oh.
But she came to town.
I see.
And I think that was probably after Bob had gotten his masters and had been away for a year.
Mm-hmm. Stored all kind of things with me, I don't remember what.
But I think mainly books, not his tapes, but his tape machine. He took them with, uh, yeah, I'm sure he did take that.
Yeah, I would like to, I would like to hear those tapes again. I'd like to hear those tapes, period, since I don't think I've ever heard the tapes.
